description:
Upgrade the domestic hot water (DHW) heater in the 4StoreyBuilding eQUEST model to reflect a high-efficiency condensing gas water heater. You must locate the DW-HEATER component(s) in the project and update three specific parameters on ALL heaters found:

1. Set 'HEAT-INPUT-RATIO' to 1.05263 (reflecting ~95% thermal efficiency).
2. Set 'TANK-UA' to 3.0 (improved standby loss).
3. Set 'AQUASTAT-SETPT-T' to 125 (tank temperature setpoint).

After updating the parameters, you must run the annual simulation to calculate the energy impact and then save the project. The task is complete when the project is saved and the simulation results are generated.
